description: Source code for generating follow-up reports in Odoo, defining a report parser class with methods to retrieve partner addresses, move lines, and follow-up texts.

classes.name: report_rappel
classes.description: Report parser class for follow-up printing, extending report_sxw.rml_parse, with methods to process partner data and generate follow-up texts.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the report parser and setting up local context with utility methods.

methods.name: _ids_to_objects
methods.description: Converts partner IDs to partner names using account_followup.stat records.

methods.name: _adr_get
methods.description: Retrieves partner address details based on partner ID and address type.

methods.name: _lines_get
methods.description: Fetches move lines for a partner that are receivable, unreconciled, and not in draft.

methods.name: _get_text
methods.description: Generates follow-up text for a partner based on follow-up lines and move lines, formatting with partner info and current date.
